Posted by Aaron Keck | Nov 13, 2026 | 6:00 News

In today’s news: Carolina football gears up for Louisville, while UNC officials plug the increasing use of AI on campus. Also: a bizarre afternoon at Carrboro High School; a Chapel Hill restaurant that’s seeking donations to stay afloat; and a call to remember the grad students on the UNC campus. And in sports: UNC men’s and women’s soccer both advance to the ACC finals, while the NCAA tournament begins for Tar Heel field hockey and cross country and the Carolina men’s and women’s basketball teams gear up for non-conference action.

97.9 The Hill WCHL and Chapelboro.com are your headquarters for local news in Chapel Hill-Carrboro. Every weekday morning, 97.9 The Hill’s Aaron Keck recaps the day’s news, from local government to business developments to UNC sports.
